sourceTitle: Natural Law in the Spiritual World
description: "Natural Law in the Spiritual World" by Henry Drummond is a philosophical work that explores the intersection of science and religion, written in the late 19th century. The text seeks to identify whether the laws governing the natural world can also apply to the spiritual realm, challenging traditional distinctions between the two areas.
